raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`test/registered/e2e/quantization/test_quark_mxfp4.py` is the most frequent failure in `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`. It failed on 2026-09-19, 09-23 through 09-28, and 09-30, on every ROCm image. The failures are not regressions: two GSM8K thresholds sit inside the normal run-to-run spread.

GSM8K accuracy collected from 36 scheduled `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` jobs (PR Test AMD + AITER Scout, rocm10/720/724, 2026-09-19 to 09-30; retries included):

| Test | Threshold | min | median | max | attempts ≤ threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.85 | 0.798 | 0.862 | 0.882 | 17 / 40 |
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.92 | 0.900 | 0.922 | 0.940 | 17 / 47 |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadMOE` | > 0.89 | 0.894 | 0.924 | 0.942 | 0 / 23 |
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4DenseTP1` | > 0.868 | 0.876 | 0.906 | 0.912 | 0 / 36 |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadDense` | > 0.85 | 0.866 | 0.870 | 0.874 | 0 / 23 |

The 09-30 rocm724 failure, for example: `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` scored 0.814 and then 0.818 on retry (`AssertionError: 0.814 not greater than 0.85`).

## History

Both thresholds have been flaky since the day each test was added. Nothing regressed later.

| Date | PR | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-03 | #18005 | Adds the file with the BF16 → MXFP4 `Dense` (> 0.85) and `MOE` (> 0.89) cases, registered in `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` |
| 2026-06-14 | #18182 (reverted the same day by #28213) | First attempt at the FP8 → MXFP4 cases |
| 2026-07-21 | #28291 | Relands FP8 → MXFP4, adding `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` (> 0.92) |
| 2026-08-14 | #29328 | Adds `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` (> 0.85) |
| 2026-09-26 | #41243 | Moves the file to `test/registered/e2e/quantization/` |

Across all scheduled PR Test (AMD) `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` jobs that ran this file between 2026-07-04 and 2026-10-02 (170 jobs; older logs have expired):

| Test | First failure | Jobs failed | Attempts ≤ threshold | min | median | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` (> 0.92) | 2026-07-22, the day after it landed: 0.912, then 0.920 on retry | 23 / 138 | 68 / 182 (37%) | 0.900 | 0.924 | 0.946 |
| `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` (> 0.85) | 2026-08-15, its first scheduled run: 0.846, then 0.832 on retry | 16 / 92 | 42 / 104 (40%) | 0.802 | 0.856 | 0.886 |

The distributions did not move when CI switched from the rocm700 image to rocm720/724/10 on 2026-09-15. Medians before and after were 0.922 → 0.924 for FP8 → MXFP4 MoE and 0.860 → 0.856 for NVFP4 → MXFP4 MoE. The BF16 `Dense`/`MOE` and `TestFP8ToMXFP4DenseTP1` cases never dropped to their thresholds.

The file stops at the first failing class. Every job where `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` failed skipped the NVFP4 and BF16 cases, so NVFP4 has fewer samples, and part of its failure rate was hidden until 2026-09.

## Modifications

Set the two flaky thresholds about 0.02 below the observed minimum and record the observed numbers next to them:

- `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1`: 0.85 → 0.78 (the old `~0.88` comment overstated the real median of 0.862).
- `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1`: 0.92 → 0.89, the same value #35477 arrived at from its own MI355X sampling (mean 0.916, min 0.898). That PR still targets the pre-#41243 path `test/registered/quant/` and does not touch the NVFP4 case.

The other three classes have no failures and are unchanged.

Companion to #41973, which fixes the same job's 30-minute timeout.

## CI results

PR Test (AMD), rocm10, [`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36809617172/job/110208833642): `test_quark_mxfp4.py` passed on the first attempt, no retries.

| Test | Threshold | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.89 (was 0.92) | 0.932 ✅ |
| `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.78 (was 0.85) | 0.874 ✅ |
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4DenseTP1` | > 0.868 | 0.882 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadDense` | > 0.85 | 0.870 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadMOE` | > 0.89 | 0.904 ✅ |

The same day on #41973's run, the old thresholds failed this file again with 0.902 (vs 0.92) and 0.836 / 0.832 (vs 0.85), all of which clear the new values.

The job itself then hit the 30-minute step limit after `test_fp4_indexer_hip.py` (600s) — the unpartitioned-suite timeout that #41973 fixes, independent of this change. Other red AMD jobs are pre-existing on `main`: `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (…, 8)` (`observability/test_tracing.py`) and a GSM8K flake in `test_int4fp8_moe.py` (0.5599 vs 0.56) in `stage-b-test-2-gpu-large-amd (…, 0)`.

After #41973 merged and this branch was synced with `main`, the [partitioned rerun](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37011670883/job/110859425653) passed `test_quark_mxfp4.py` again. `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` scored exactly 0.850 there, which the old `> 0.85` check would have failed. The two red mi35x parts in that run fail on files that also fail on `main` (`amd/test_dsv4_hip_bcg_metadata.py`, `kernels/ops/quantization/test_mxfp8_amd_gfx95.py`).

After merging `main` on 2026-10-08, the [rerun](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37708981284) passed `test_quark_mxfp4.py` again on the first attempt, in [`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37708981284/job/113095585860):

| Test | Threshold | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.89 (was 0.92) | 0.936 ✅ |
| `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.78 (was 0.85) | 0.822 ✅ |
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4DenseTP1` | > 0.868 | 0.884 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadDense` | > 0.85 | 0.868 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadMOE` | > 0.89 | 0.924 ✅ |

`TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` scored 0.822, which the old `> 0.85` check would have failed. The scheduled `main` run a few hours earlier still fails this file: [`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37709475489/job/113091796031) scored 0.916 for `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` against `> 0.92`, and 0.916 again on retry.

The remaining red AMD jobs in the rerun fail on files this PR does not touch, and each fails on `main` as well:

| Job | Failing file | Fails on `main` |
|---|---|---|
| `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x (…, 0)` | `kernels/ops/attention/test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py` | run 37709475489 |
| `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x (…, 1)` | `kernels/ops/quantization/test_mxfp8_amd_gfx95.py` | run 37709475489 |
| `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (…, 2)` | `attention/test_kda_kernels.py` | run 37776737975 |
| `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (…, 7)` | `amd/test_minimax_indexer_cp.py` | run 37709475489 |
| `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (…, 8)` | `observability/test_tracing.py` | run 37776737975 |

`stage-b-test-large-8-gpu-mi35x-disaggregation-amd` fails `amd/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_pp.py` with `KVTransferError` on decode and prefill transfers. That job is intermittent on `main` independently of this PR: 0/4 passed in runs 37127367120 and 37144253589, 4/4 in run 37709475489.

After another merge from `main` on 2026-10-12, the [rerun](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38203072943) passed `test_quark_mxfp4.py` on the first attempt again, in [`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38203072943/job/114663775382):

| Test | Threshold | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.89 (was 0.92) | 0.918 ✅ |
| `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` | > 0.78 (was 0.85) | 0.860 ✅ |
| `TestFP8ToMXFP4DenseTP1` | > 0.868 | 0.884 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadDense` | > 0.85 | 0.868 ✅ |
| `TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoadMOE` | > 0.89 | 0.916 ✅ |

Each of the three reruns produced a score the old thresholds reject, on a different test each time:

| Rerun | Score | Old check |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-02 | `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` 0.850 | > 0.85 |
| 2026-10-08 | `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` 0.822 | > 0.85 |
| 2026-10-12 | `TestFP8ToMXFP4MOETP1` 0.918 | > 0.92 |

The scheduled `main` run the same night, [`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0 of 38189648453](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38189648453/job/114619494932), still fails this file: `TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1` scored 0.822, then 0.838 on retry, against `> 0.85`. That job fails `kernels/ops/attention/test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py` as well, the same file that reddens part 0 here.

The other red jobs in the 10-12 run also fail on `main` in run 38189648453: `kernels/ops/attention/dsv4/test_compact_attention_hip.py` on mi35x part 1, and `observability/test_tracing.py` on `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (…, 12)`. `stage-b-test-large-8-gpu-mi35x-disaggregation-amd` fails `test_disaggregation_pp.py` again. `build-test (xeon-spr, …)` fails in `cpu/test_subblock_sparse_attention.py`, whose imports reach `vsa/__init__.py`, which calls `torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)` at import time on a CPU-only runner.

The `PR Test Extra` checks are red only because this PR carries `run-ci` without `run-ci-extra`.

## Checklist

- [x] `black --check` passes.
- [x] PR Test (AMD) run: `test_quark_mxfp4.py` passes all five GSM8K checks on the first attempt.

@@ -220,9 +220,9 @@ class TestNVFP4ToMXFP4MOETP1(TestOnlineQuantizationMemoryLoad):
     tp = 1
 
     def test_gsm8k(self):
-        # Requantized NVFP4 -> MXFP4 observed accuracy: ~0.88
-        # (BF16 Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B reference: ~0.94).
-        self._test_gsm8k(accuracy_threshold=0.85)
+        # Requantized NVFP4 -> MXFP4 observed accuracy on MI355X CI: median
+        # 0.862, min 0.798 over 40 runs (BF16 Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B reference: ~0.94).
